request.instruction: Rewrite ONLY [AUTHORIZED_SPAN] of the contract paragraph so that EVERY listed obligation is carried out at the same time. Keep all text outside the authorized span byte-identical. Preserve fee rates, percentages, amounts, dates, subjects, formulas, accounts, share classes and every fee topic unless an obligation explicitly removes it. Do not introduce a number that is not in the source, the guide text or the verified facts. Return the complete replacement for the span, not a diff. List the source literals you preserved.

response.basis: G13 requires deleting the sentence about charging a redemption fee of no less than 1.50% for investors holding fewer than 7 days and including it fully in fund assets. The authorized span contains only that sentence, so the replacement is empty and no source literals remain.
